symptoms: Fine yellow stippling or bronzing on upper leaf surfaces
Delicate fine webbing visible between veins and leaf petioles
Leaves turn chlorotic, dry out, and acquire a brittle bleached texture
risk_factors: Hot, dry, and dusty conditions (>30°C and low humidity)
Overuse of broad-spectrum synthetic insecticides killing natural predators
prevention: Maintain adequate soil moisture and avoid water stress
Hose down dusty perimeter roads and garden borders
recommended_actions: Apply insecticidal soap, neem oil, or horticultural oils to leaf undersides
Introduce predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis) for biological control
